sections.title: Reporting a broken machine
sections.content: működik ("to work, to function") is the verb you need for machines and systems that stop doing their job: a klíma, a lift, a wifi. Just put nem in front: Nem működik a klíma. ("The air conditioning doesn't work.") The broken thing is the subject, and it comes after the verb, the same way van/nincs sentences work.

items.spanish: A szobában nem működik a klíma.
items.english: The air conditioning in the room doesn't work.

items.spanish: A lift nem működik, menjünk lépcsőn.
items.english: The elevator doesn't work, let's take the stairs.

sections.content: működik describes the machine itself — the thing 'doesn't function'. hibás describes the same situation from a different angle: it's an adjective meaning 'faulty', so A klíma hibás and Nem működik a klíma both report the same problem, just with a different word doing the work.
